verdict.rationale: Angular is a framework, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it and the axis applies. The evidence only mentions generic 'AI-forward resources and integrations', an AI prompts section and an llms.txt file. None of these documents an official MCP server an agent can connect to, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
